# Batch memoization of exact replacement witnesses

Use the pinned MBTA development projection and its 48 hypothetical single-trip cancellations. Keep the original 512 requests as the primary workload. Use a second development workload with the same four destinations and request count, taking the first 16 original requests per destination and expanding each into eight consecutive departure times at its original station. Use the original start as the beginning of each burst, shifted earlier only if needed to keep the burst inside the horizon. This models local reuse under shared origins and closely spaced request times. It changes the realized OD sample, so compare methods within each workload.

Compare four methods. Use the existing indexed connection scan and unmodified one-word signature repair. Add a matched signature control that uses the same base ride index and allocation heuristic as the candidate. The control walks repaired event edges and skips waiting edges when it returns to a certified base suffix. The candidate also memoizes the first ride of a repaired suffix by destination and event, within a single cancellation batch. A repaired suffix can begin with a waiting chain. Its first ride is the first ride of the selected successor until a ride or terminal label is reached. After emitting a ride, continue from its arrival event. Every solver returns owned vectors of complete rides in input query order. Only base preprocessing can be reused across cancellations.

Time setup separately using the median of seven construction repetitions. Shuffle methods within each setup repetition and timed batch repetition. Use one untimed batch per method and cancellation, and time 15 runs including batch dispatch, repair, witness allocation and copying. Exclude common graph ingestion, result disposal and serialization. Evaluate nearest-rank p95 and geometric mean of the 48 per-cancellation median batch latencies. Add median setup divided by 48 to each batch latency before summarizing amortized results. Retain the exploratory threshold of at least 10% lower latency across all four summaries against all controls, applying it separately per workload. An independent station oracle checks arrivals and the complete witnesses. Require identical witnesses across the three signature methods and agreement across timing repetitions. Save misses as well as wins. Use one logical CPU in the 10–19 range and no reserved networks.
